title: GCF Funding Approval Criteria 2024
text: Green Climate Fund prioritizes projects with CO2 reduction above 5000 t/yr and verifiable social impact metrics. Budget efficiency (CO2 per dollar) above 3.0 strongly correlates with approval. Projects below 2.0 face increased scrutiny.

title: Reforestation Project Kenya 2023
text: 2.4M USD reforestation in Kenya, 6800 t/yr CO2 capture, 78 social impact, 24 month duration. Approved with 0.84 ML probability. Key driver: high CO2 efficiency (2.83 t/$) and community ownership model.

title: Solar Microgrid Tanzania 2022
text: 1.8M USD solar microgrid, 4200 t/yr displaced diesel emissions, 82 social impact (rural electrification). 18 month duration. ML probability 0.79. Validated by IRENA monitoring.

title: Failed Wind Farm Mongolia 2021
text: 5.2M USD wind project, only 800 t/yr CO2 reduction due to grid losses, 32 social impact. Probability 0.21. Key issue: low CO2/dollar ratio (0.15) and 36-month timeline exceeded EBRD risk threshold.

title: IPCC AR6 Mitigation Pathways
text: Per IPCC AR6 WG3 Chapter 7, AFOLU sector projects with co-benefits (biodiversity, livelihoods) score higher than pure carbon offset schemes. Social impact above 60 is correlated with longer-term carbon retention.

title: EU Taxonomy Climate DNSH
text: EU Taxonomy requires Do No Significant Harm verification: projects with budget over 5M USD and duration above 30 months must demonstrate climate adaptation co-benefit. Pure mitigation projects without adaptation often fail DNSH review.

title: Mangrove Restoration Indonesia 2024
text: 3.1M USD mangrove restoration West Java, 5400 t/yr blue carbon sequestration, 88 social impact (fisheries, storm protection). 30 month duration. ML probability 0.91. Funded by GCF + Asian Development Bank.

title: Cookstoves Ghana 2020 Pull-back
text: 4.8M USD cookstove distribution, 2100 t/yr claimed CO2 reduction, 45 social impact. Probability 0.38. Pulled back after MRV showed only 38% adoption rate after 12 months. Lesson: cultural fit critical for behavioral change projects.

title: Soil Carbon US Midwest 2023
text: 1.2M USD soil carbon sequestration program, 3800 t/yr verified by Verra, 55 social impact (farmer income). 36 month duration. Probability 0.68. Notable: high CO2 efficiency (3.17 t/$) offset moderate social score.

title: GIIN Impact Investing Principles
text: GIIN IRIS+ framework emphasizes additionality and intentionality. Projects must demonstrate that climate outcomes would not occur without the investment. Co-benefits score weighted at 30% of total impact rating.

title: Biochar Pilot Sweden 2024
text: 800k USD biochar production, 1200 t/yr CO2 removal certified by Puro.earth, 42 social impact. 12 month duration. ML probability 0.62. Strength: durable carbon (1000+ years), weakness: limited social co-benefit.

title: Article 6.4 Paris Agreement
text: Article 6.4 mechanism requires real, additional, verified, conservative emission reductions. Crediting period 5-15 years. Corresponding adjustments avoid double-counting. Projects under 2 t/$ efficiency rarely qualify.

title: Geothermal Indonesia 2022
text: 12M USD geothermal expansion Java, 35000 t/yr CO2 displacement of coal, 70 social impact (jobs + grid stability). 48 month duration. Probability 0.81. Note: large budget compensated by strong CO2/$ (2.92).

title: Refrigerant Recovery Program 2023
text: 2.3M USD HFC refrigerant capture, 8900 CO2-eq t/yr (high GWP avoidance), 35 social impact. 24 month. Probability 0.74. Insight: high CO2/$ (3.87) outweighed lower social score in funder eligibility.

title: Direct Air Capture Iceland 2024
text: 15M USD DAC pilot, 4000 t/yr permanent removal, 50 social impact (R&D jobs). 36 month duration. Probability 0.41. Reasoning: low CO2/$ (0.27) and budget exceeded most funders' single-project caps.

title: World Bank Climate-Smart Agriculture
text: World Bank CSA portfolio favors projects with 3+ year horizon, social impact above 65, and verifiable yield co-benefit. CO2 reduction often secondary metric to adaptation outcomes.

title: Rooftop Solar Bangladesh 2023
text: 950k USD rooftop solar program rural Bangladesh, 1800 t/yr displaced kerosene, 90 social impact (women-led). 18 month. Probability 0.86. Key: exceptional social score and CO2/$ of 1.89.

title: Failed REDD+ Brazil 2019
text: 8M USD REDD+ project Para state, claimed 12000 t/yr avoided deforestation, 40 social impact. Probability 0.29. Issue: leakage and reversal risk; satellite MRV showed 47% deforestation in adjacent unprotected zones.

title: TCFD Reporting Climate Risk
text: TCFD framework requires scenario analysis (1.5C, 2C, 3C). Funders increasingly require climate risk disclosure for projects above 3M USD or above 24 months. Lack of TCFD alignment reduces probability by 0.10-0.15.

title: E-Mobility Vietnam 2024
text: 4.5M USD e-bike fleet for delivery cooperatives, 6500 t/yr CO2 displacement, 75 social impact (gig worker income). 24 month. Probability 0.83. Strong CO2/$ (1.44) plus social signal.
